items.title: Exactness of the small inverse image and its effect on stalks and representable sheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four properties of the small inverse image: exactness on abelian sheaves and on sheaves of sets, the identification of stalks under pullback, and the identity f^{-1}h_V = h_{X x_Y V} (statement lines 4648-4668). Each part is proved separately inside the counted span: exactness from the colimit description of the inverse image (proof lines 4670-4684), the stalk computation through the description of stalks as colimits over etale neighbourhoods (proof lines 4687-4708), and the representable case, for which the author offers two arguments, one direct and one through the previous parts (proof lines 4711-4723). The content is the comparison of colimits in each case. The claim is H2: four short computations of the same flavour.
